description_en: Enables the failover feature for replication pairs in a replication pair-consistent group. When the primary disks of specific replication pairs in a replication pair-consistent group fail, you can call this operation to enable the read and write permissions on the secondary disks
description_zh: 启用一致性复制组中复制对的故障切换功能。当一致性复制组中某些复制对的主盘出现故障时，可以调用该接口恢复从盘的读写权限
kebab_example: aliyun ebs failover-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id group-myreplica0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FailoverDiskReplicaGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the secondary site of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.help_zh: 一致性复制组中容灾站点所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group
parameters.name: replica_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
